finding: The 10k registration collapse (199/10000) is a seed-selection failure, not a track-build or matching-quality failure. The multi-seed search caps how many pairs *grow* a reconstruction at seed_trials (16). At 2.5k/5k the 16 successful grows include a seed that reaches most of the connected component (reach 875 / 1183); at 10k all 16 successful grows are weak (max reach 169) and the strong seeds that win at 5k (e.g. pair (1750,1758), reach 875) are never reached before the 16-success cap cuts the search off.

seed_gate_detail.observation: Almost every seed pair passes the two-view relative-pose test with ~95 inliers but triangulates almost nothing: e.g. pair (0,1) inliers=96 well_triangulated=1 against min_seed_matches=30. Only ~16 of ~8000 attempted pairs produce >=30 well-triangulated points, and those cluster at image ids 2500-2517 and 400/3000/5000.
seed_gate_detail.why: place_seed_pair requires >= min_seed_matches (30) triangulatable correspondences. Adjacent low-parallax frames satisfy the epipolar geometry but have essentially no baseline, so they never seed. The scene's genuinely wide-baseline pairs are the few that pass; the winner_reach difference is how far each of those then grows.

track_build_is_scale_invariant.conclusion: Same-image conflict ratio and retained-observations-per-component are essentially identical at 5k and 10k, so the union-find track builder does not degrade with scale.

root_cause: seed_candidate_order ranks pairs by matches.len() descending, which does not predict growth reach. The search then stops after seed_trials successful grows. On a connected 10k sequence the strongest-match pairs are temporally adjacent low-baseline pairs that barely grow; the wide-baseline seeds that do grow are later in the order and never tried.

fix.change: Add IncrementalSfmConfig::seed_attempts (CLI --seed-attempts, runner --seed-attempts). It bounds *growth attempts*, independent of seed_trials (which counts successful grows). A success whose reach is below a quarter of the connected component no longer stops the search; only a seed reaching >= half the component (not_trapped) does. 0 preserves the old seed_trials behaviour, so existing configs are unchanged.
fix.non_regression_tier_2500: Default seed_attempts=0 gives 1223 / 4226 / 1.766 px, identical to before; cargo test -p visloc-slam --lib 787 passed.

control: colmap:latest model0 registers 8988 of 10000 images (both cameras, frames 0-4493) as one model, so the target component is ~9000, not the port's 199. seed_attempts=512 recovers 1205 (roughly the 1.2k plateau seen at 2.5k/5k) but is still far short of 8988, so a second limitation remains in single-seed growth reach.
